- First-month-free is SHARED HOSTING ONLY (do not show it on VPS/email/game).

1. Pricing Page: tighten/upgrade the existing hub — clearer per-product comparison tables, a stronger "which product is right for me?" chooser, consistent CTAs to /register, a shared trust row. Make it genuinely better/more polished, not a rewrite.
2. Better Compare Pages: improve the comparison/competitor-alternative pages (whatever exists) — accurate, honest feature/price comparisons vs competitors, DB-fed Nxeon prices, no fabricated competitor data (use only widely-known public facts or neutral "varies" where unknown — NEVER invent competitor prices/claims). Better layout, clearer tables, honest framing.

Keep everything truthful (no fabricated stats/reviews/competitor numbers). DELIVER, then commit `git add -A && git commit -m "feat: polish /pricing hub + improve compare pages (DB-fed, honest)"` (trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>), `git push -u origin feature/pricing-compare-pages`. REPORT (factual): files changed, which compare pages you improved, confirm prices are DB-fed and no fabricated competitor data, anything deferred. Don't claim tested.
